Type: handcrafted geometric wool rug
Use: defining a seating or reading area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: wool and cotton, flat textured weave
Colors: dark taupe brown, cream
Shape: rectangular, bold zigzag chevron bands of fine stripes with dotted rows, flat low profile, medium size
Feel: graphic, earthy, warm, structured
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets, white walls; modern or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Handcrafted Wool-and-Cotton Rug with Undulating Stripes, 5' x 8', Cream and Taupe
product.description: This handcrafted rug is created with space-dyed wool yarn to give its soft, durable pile a subtle but rich color. The undulating stripes of taupe and cream make it easy to blend this rug with any existing color scheme, and the pattern will give your space added texture. 5'W x 8'L Pile: 100% wool; backing: 100% cotton Handcrafted by artisans in India using a looped-and-cut technique and space-dyed yarns to give subtle color Pair with a rug pad (sold separately)
